VBO:0201380.summary: Intelligent, according to Utonagan Society contributor Nadia Carlyle, these dogs came from a British breeding project begun in the 1980s. Her 2005 account records Mahtal Iskote at Carrara appearing in the Crufts Good Citizens’ ring for the Pets as Therapy parade. The society was also organizing breeder support and a rescue network.
VBO:0201380.shortDescription: Utonagan were described as intelligent, with a recorded 2005 Pets as Therapy parade appearance at Crufts.
